tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /theg pa chen po rgyud bla ma'i don gyi snying po gsal byed kyi snang ba chen po zhes bya ba bzhugs/
༄༅/ /theg pa chen po rgyud bla ma'i don gyi snying po gsal byed kyi snang ba chen po zhes bya ba bzhugs/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /theg pa chen po rgyud bla ma'i don gyi snying po gsal byed kyi snang ba chen po zhes bya ba bzhugs/

ma lus 'gro ba'i skyabs gcig bcom ldan 'das/ /de sras thu bo mi pham 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /rgyal bas lung bstan klu sgrub thogs med sogs/ /'dzam gling mkhas pa'i tshogs la gus btud nas/ /rgyal ba'i dgongs pa mi pham mgon nyid kyis/ /ji bzhin bkral ba'i rdo rje'i don bdun nyid/ /rgyal ba gnyis pa yab sras kyis phye ba'i/ /'khrul med srol bzhin mdor bsdus bshad par bya/ /de la 'dir rje btsun byams mgon gyis mdzad pa'i byams chos sde lnga zhes yongs su grags pa'i nang tshan bstan bcos rgyud bla ma'i brjod bya'i don gyi snying bo bsdus nas/ rang gzhan la phan pa dang*/ khyad par bdag nyid kyis ring nas rje btsun 'di'i dgongs pa 'di bzhin 'chad rgyu zhig byung na snyam pa'i 'dun pas bskul te 'chad pa la gnyis/ bshad bya'i sdom dgod pa dang*/ de'i don bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ rgyud bla ma las/ sangs rgyas chos tshogs khams dang byang chub dang*/ /yon tan sangs rgyas 'phrin las tha ma ste/ /bstan bcos kun gyi lus ni mdor bsdu na/ /rdo rje yi ni gnas bdun 'di dag go /zhes so/ /gnyis pa la gnyis/ dngos dang*/ phan yon no/ /dang po la bdun te/ sangs rgyas dkon mchog dang*/ chos dang*/ dge 'dun dang*/ khams dang*/ byang chub dang*/ yon tan dang*/ 'phrin las so/ /dang po la gsum/ mtshan nyid/ dbye ba/ skyabs kyi khyad par ro/ /'dus ma byas sogs yon tan brgyad po gang rung dang ldan pa'i skyabs gnas mthar thug 'dir sangs rgyas dkon mchog gi mtshan nyid/ sangs rgyas dkon mchog de yon tan brgyad dang ldan pa yin te/ rang don chos sku'i dbang du byas te skye 'jig dang bral ba'i 'dus ma byas rang bzhin rnam dag dang*/ 'bad rtsol nye bar zhi ba'i gzhan don lhun gyis grub pa glo bur rnam dag dang*/ so so rang rig pa ji lta ba rtogs pa'i ye shes kyis mngon sum du rtogs kyi sgra rtog tsam gyis rdzogs par rtogs mi nus pa'i yon tan dang*/

gzhan don gzugs sku la yod pa'i dbang du mdzad nas ji snyed pa mtha' dag mkhyen pa'i ye shes dang*/ brtse ba thugs rje chen po dang*/ de gnyis kyi nus pa'i yon tan dang ldan cing*/ dang po gsum sdud byed kyi rang don phun tshogs dang*/ phyi ma gsum sdud byed kyi gzhan don phun tshogs gnyis te yon tan brgyad dang ldan pa'i phyir te/ rgyud bla ma las/ 'dus ma byas shing lhun gyis grub/ /gzhan gyi rkyen gyis rtogs min pa/ /mkhyen dang brtse dang nus par ldan/ /don gnyis ldan pa'i sangs rgyas nyid/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir dang*/ sgrub byed kyang de nyid las/ rang bzhin yin phyir 'dus ma byas/ /zhi ba chos kyi sku can phyir/ /lhun gyis grub ces bya bar brjod/ /so so rang gis rtogs bya'i phyir/ /gzhan gyi rkyen gyis rtogs min pa/ /de ltar rnam gsum rtogs phyir mkhyen/ /lam ston phyir na thugs brtse ba/ /nus pa ye shes thugs rje yis/ / sdug bsngal nyon mongs spong phyir ro/ /dang po gsum gyis rang don te/ /phyi ma gsum gyis gzhan don yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /gnyis pa dbye na/ rang don chos sku dang*/ gzhan don gzugs sku gnyis so/ /dang po la mtshan nyid dang*/ dbye ba'o/ /gtso bor ye shes kyis thob pas rab tu phye ba'i thob bya mthar thug /chos sku'i mtshan nyid/ de yang don gtso bor byas pa ste/ gzhan du na zhib cha dgos so/ /dbye na/ spangs pa mthar thug dang*/ rtogs pa mthar thug go /dag pa gnyis ldan gyi dbyings mthar thug /spangs pa mthar thug gi mtshan nyid/ ldog pas phye na/ rang bzhin rnam dag dang*/ glo bur rnam dag gi sku gnyis te/ 'dir de gnyis don gcig ming gis rnam grangs tsam du bya'o/ /de'i dang po ni/ rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa'i dbyings mthar thug pa'i sku ste/ rang bzhin rnam dag gi ngo bo nyid sku'i mtshan nyid kyang yin no/ /gnyis pa ni/ glo bur gyi dri ma mtha' dag spangs pa'i khyad par du byas pa'i chos nyid kyi sku ste/

glo bur rnam dag gi ngo bo nyid sku'i mtshan nyid kyang yin no/ /gnyis pa rtogs pa mthar thug la/ ji lta ji snyed mkhyen pa'i ye shes mthar thug gnyis so/ /ldog pas phye ba tsam ste/ gnyis ka yin khyab yin la/ mtshan nyid kyang go sla'o/ /gnyis pa la mtshan nyid dang*/ dbye ba'o/ /dang po ni/ gtso bor bsod nams kyi tshogs kyis thob pas rab tu phye ba'i thob bya mthar thug tu gyur pa'i 'phags pa/ gzugs sku'i mtshan nyid/ dbye na/ longs sku dang*/ sprul sku'o/ /nges pa lnga dang ldan pa'i gzugs sku/ longs sku'i mtshan nyid/ nges pa lnga dang mi ldan pa'i gzugs sku/ sprul sku'i mtshan nyid/ dbye na/ mchog gi sprul sku sogs gsum mo/ /'dir mtshon tsam ste/ lhag ma 'ga' zhig byang chub kyi skabs su bshad par bya'o/ /gnyis pa chos dkon mchog la mtshan nyid dang*/ dbye ba'o/ /dang po ni/ bsam du med pa sogs yon tan brgyad po gang rung dang ldan pa'i rnam byang bden pa/ chos dkon mchog gi mtshan nyid/ chos dkon mchog de yon tan brgyad dang ldan pa yin te/ 'gog bden gyi dbang du byas na yod med kyi mtha' bzhir bsam du med pa dang*/ las nyon gnyis ci rigs med pa'i zhi ba dang*/ bden 'dzin gyi rnam rtog med pa'i yon tan rnams dang*/ lam bden gyi dbang du byas nas nyi ma dang 'dra ba'i ye shes dri mas dag pa dang*/ de kho na nyid gsal ba dang*/ mi mthun phyogs kyi gnyen po'i yon tan rnams dang*/ snga ma gsum sdud byed gang zhig chags pa dang bral ba don dam 'gog bden dang*/ phyi ma gsum sdud byed gang gis chags pa dang bral byed kun rdzob lam bden gyi yon tan gnyis te brgyad dang ldan pa'i phyir te/ de nyid las/ bsam med gnyis med rtog med pa/ /dag gsal gnyen po'i phyogs nyid kyis/ /gang zhig gang gis chags bral ba/ /bden gnyis mtshan nyid can de chos/ /chags bral nyid ni 'gog pa dang*/ /lam gyi bden pa dag gis bsdus/

/zhes gsungs pa'i phyir dang*/ sgrub byed kyang*/ de nyid las/ go rim bzhin du de dag kyang*/ /yon tan gsum gsum gyis rig bya/ /brtag min phyir dang brjod min phyir/ /'phags pas mkhyen phyir bsam med nyid/ /zhi nyid gnyis med rtog med de/ /dag sogs gsum ni nyi bzhin no/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /gnyis pa dbye na/ 'gog bden dang*/ lam bden gnyis so/ /dang po la mtshan nyid dang*/ dbye ba'o/ /lam bden gyi stobs kyis thob pa'i bral 'bras/ 'gog bden gyi mtshan nyid/ dbye na theg pa gsum gyi dbye bas gsum mo/ /'gog bden thob byed kyi rigs su gnas pa'i rnam byang bden pa/ lam bden gyi mtshan nyid/ dbye na sngar ltar gsum mo/ /chos dkon mchog dngos ni/ de gnyis yin gyi/ lung gi chos rnams ni de dngos min no/ /gsum pa dge 'dun dkon mchog la mtshan nyid dang*/ dbye ba'o/ /rig grol gyi yon tan brgyad po gang rung dang ldan pa'i 'phags pa/dge 'dun dkon mchog gi mtshan nyid/ dbye na/theg pa che chung gi dge 'dun dkon mchog gnyis/ de brgyad po gang rung dang ldan pa'i theg chen 'phags pa/ theg chen gyi dge 'dun dkon mchog gi mtshan nyid/ theg chen gyi dge 'dun dkon mchog de rig grol gyi yon tan brgyad dang ldan pa yin te/ 'gro sogs chos thams cad kyi chos nyid rtogs pa ji lta ba rig pa/ rigs yod pa sogs kun rdzob pa'i chos rnams rtogs pa ji snyed pa rig pa/ ye shes de gnyis rtogs pa so so rang gis rig pa'i yon tan dang*/ 'dod chags sogs chags sgrib/ ma rig bag chags sogs thogs sgrib/ rang nyid gcig pu zhi bde sogs dman sgrib las grol ba gsum dang*/ snga ma gsum sdud byed kyi rig pa'i yon tan dang*/ phyi ma gsum sdud byed kyi grol ba'i yon tan gnyis te brgyad dang ldan pa'i phyir te/ de nyid las/ ji lta ji snyed nang gi ni/ /ye shes gzigs pa dag pa'i phyir/

/blo ldan phyir mi ldog pa'i tshogs/ /bla med yon tan dang ldan nyid/ /zhes gsungs shing*/ sgrub byed kyang der/ 'gro ba'i zhi ba'i chos nyid du/ /rtogs phyir ji lta nyid de yang*/ /rang bzhin gyis ni yongs dag phyir/ /nyon mongs gdod nas zad phyir ro/ /shes bya mthar thug rtogs pa'i blos/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i chos nyid ni/ sems can thams cad la yod par/ /mthong phyir ji snyed yod pa nyid/ /de ltar rtogs pa gang yin de/ /so so rang shes mthong ba nyid/ /dri med dbyings la chags med dang*/ /thogs med phyir de dag pa yin/ /ye shes gzigs pa dag pas na/ /sangs rgyas ye shes bla med phyir/ /'phags pa phyir mi ldog pa ni/ / lus can kun gyi skyabs yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar te/ rkang ba phyi ma gnyis kyis dman sgrib las grol bar bstan pa yin no/ /gzhung 'dis ji snyed pa gzigs pa'i ye shes 'chad pa'i tshe sems can thams cad la sangs rgyas kyi rigs yod par rtogs pa'i cha nas bshad pa ni dgos pa dang bcas pa'o/ /gsum pa la gnyis/ skyabs gsum du 'jog pa'i tshul/ don dam pa'i skyabs dang kun rdzob pa'i skyabs kyi khyad par ro/ /dang po ni/ spyir rigs can gsum gyis dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba yin te/ de gsum gyis sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la skyabs ston pa po dang*/ dam pa'i chos la skyabs dngos dang*/ dge 'dun la skyabs sgrub pa'i zla grogs su dam bca' ba'i sgo nas skyabs su 'gro ba'i phyir/ so so'i dbang du byas na nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang rang rgyal gyis chos dang theg chen gyi rigs can gyis sangs rgyas dkon mchog la gtso bor skyabs su 'gro ba'i sgo nas de gsum gyi skyabs su bzhag pa dang*/ lam du ma zhugs kyang dkon mchog gsum la so sor mchod pa sogs bya ba byed pa'i mos pa gsum gyi dbang du byas nas/ dkon mchog gsum rigs can gsum gyi skabs su bzhag pa yin te/

de nyid las/ ston pa bstan pa slob don gyis/ /theg pa gsum dang byed gsum la/ /mos pa rnams kyi dbang mdzad nas/ /skyabs gsum rnam par bzhag pa yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /gnyis pa la/ don dam pa'i skyabs ni/ lam gyi bgrod pa mthar phyin pa'i sangs rgyas kho na la byed cing*/ kun rdzob pa'i skyabs ni de las ldog pa ste/ de nyid las/ dam pa'i don du 'gro ba yi/ /skyabs ni sangs rgyas nyag gcig yin/ /zhes so/ /dkon mchog zhes brjod pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ de nyid las/ 'byung ba dkon phyir dri med phyir/ /mthu ldan phyir dang 'jig rten gyi/ /rgyan gyur phyir dang mchog nyid phyir/ /'gyur ba med phyir dkon mchog nyid/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /bzhi ba rgyu rigs sam khams la bzhi/ mtshan nyid/ dbye ba/ so so'i don/ sems can thams cad la sangs rgyas kyi rigs yod pa'i sgrub byed do/ /dang po la/ 'dir khams zhes pa rigs kyi don yin pas sbyir/ sangs rgyas su 'gyur rung*/ sangs rgyas kyi rigs kyi mtshan nyid/ dbye na/ rang bzhin gnas rigs dang*/ rgyas 'gyur gyi rigs gnyis/ dang po la mtshan nyid dang*/ dbye ba'o/ /sems can gyi rgyud kyi chos skur 'gyur rung gis bsdus pa'i de bzhin nyid/ rang bzhin gnas rigs kyi mtshan nyid/ dbye na/ lam du zhugs ma zhugs kyi gang zag gi rgyud kyi rang bzhin gnas rigs gnyis sam/ theg pa gsum gyi dbye bas gsum/ gnyis pa la mtshan nyid dang*/ dbye ba'o/ /'dus byas kyis bsdus pa'i sangs rgyas kyi skur 'gyur rung*/ rgyas 'gyur gyi rigs kyi mtshan nyid/ lam du zhugs ma zhugs dang theg pa'i dbye bas sngar ltar ro/ /gsum pa rang bzhin gnas rigs dang*/ rgyas 'gyur gyi rigs gnyis las phyi ma ni/ sems can dang de'i rgyud kyi dge ba'i sems sems byung rnams dang ldan min 'du byed kyi bsdus pa 'ga' zhig dang*/ khyad par nges 'byung snying rje chen po byang chub kyi sems stong nyid rtogs pa'i shes rab sogs la byed cing*/

de thams cad sangs rgyas kyi rigs yin pas sangs rgyas su 'gyur ba yin la/ de yang sangs rgyas kyi sa'i 'dus byas kyi skur 'gyur rung yin te go sla'o/ /snga ma rang bzhin gnas rigs ni/ sangs rgyas kyi sa'i ngo bo nyid skur 'gyur rung yin la/ de ni sems can thams cad kyi sems rang bzhin gyis stong pa nyid la 'jog pa yin gyi/ gzhan la min no/ /sems can thams cad 'tshang rgya ba'i rgyu mtshan yang*/ sems can thams cad kyi rgyud la spyir sangs rgyas kyi rigs yod pas yin la/ khyad par rang bzhin gnas rigs yod pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis yin no/ /des na sems can thams cad mthar 'tshang rgya zhes pa ni/ gzhan gyi tshig rjes 'brang ba tsam ma yin par lung dang rigs pa yang dag gis nges pa la/ sems can thams cad kyi sems bden pas stong tshul legs par nges dgos/ de la spyir bden gnyis kyi 'jog tshul legs par shes dgos/ khyad par chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis grub pa rdul tsam yang med pa dang*/ bya byed kyi rten 'brel 'thad pa gnyis mi 'gal ba'i tshul legs par shes dgos/ de la brten nas sems rang bzhin gyis ma grub pa'i 'od gsal ba dang*/ dri ma rnams sprin bzhin du glo bur ba yin tshul shes dgos/ de la brten nas dri ma gnyen po'i stobs kyis spong nus shing*/ lam bsgoms na ni mthar 'tshang rgya ba'i tshul rnams la tshig tsam ma yin par rigs pa yang dag gis nges pa rnyed dgos pas/ rang bzhin gnas rigs ming tsam gyis 'jog sla yang*/ don legs par nges pa'i sgo nas 'jog shin du dka' 'o/ /sems can thams cad 'tshang rgya zhes pa yang thob byed kyi thabs lam bsgoms pa zhig byung na de la brten nas rim gyis 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur zhes pa'i don yin gyi/ 'bad med du grol ba min te/ rdzu 'phrul thob na nam mkha' la 'gro nus zhes pa bzhin no/ /rigs kyi gnas tshul mtha' dag rtogs dka' ba la dgongs nas/

rgyud bla ma las/ dkon mchog gsum po 'di yi rigs/ /thams cad gzigs pa rnams kyi yul/ /de yang rnam bzhi go rim bzhin/ /rgyu bzhi yis ni bsam mi khyab/ /zhes sogs gsungs te/ mang du dogs nas ma bris so/ /des na ji srid thal 'gyur ba ltar bden gnyis kyi rnam bzhag spyi dang khyad par 'khor 'das kyi chos rnams rang bzhin gyis grub pa rdul tsam yang med pa dang*/ kun rdzob kyi bya byed thams cad 'thad pa'i gnyis tshogs de 'gal med 'thad ldan du snying nas 'jog mi thub pa de srid du bden gnyis 'jog tshul legs par mi shes pas/ sems can thams cad 'tshang rgya zhes khas blangs kyang tshig rjes 'brang ba'i dam bca' tsam zhig tu zad pa'i phyir na/ da lta'i byis pa'i blo can dag gis ni sgra spyi tsam zhig las legs par mthong snyam pa med do/ /sems can gyi sems rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa de nyid lam gyis rtogs shing goms par byas pa'i mthar sems rgyud kyi steng du glo bur gyi dri ma mtha' dag slar mi skye ba'i chos can du byas pa'i tshul gyis zad cing bkag pa na/ ngo bo nyid skur gyur ba yin la/ der ma gyur bar du dri ma ma spangs pa'i chos nyid yin pas/ de la rang bzhin gnas rigs dang de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying bo zhes bya zhing*/ de dang rgyas 'gyur gyi rigs gnyis ka'ang sems can thams cad la yod pas/ sems can thams cad de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying bo can zhes bya ste/ rgyud bla ma las/ rigs yod phyir na lus can kun/ /rtag tu sangs rgyas snying bo can/ /zhes gsungs so/ /skyabs 'gro dang dad pa dang snying rje dang byams pa dang dge ba la spro ba sogs yod na/ rigs kyi rtags khyad par can yin no/ /shar nub kyi nam mkha'i ngo bo la rigs mi 'dra ba med pa ltar sems can gyi sems bden stong dang sangs rgyas kyi thugs bden stong gnyis ngo bo la rigs mi 'dra ba'i tha dad med kyang*/

dri ma dang bcas ma bcas kyi dbang gis ldog pa tha dad du 'jog pa yin la/ bden stong gnyis ka snga phyi thams cad la yod cing*/ khyad par bden stong phyi ma ngo bo nyid sku yin yang*/ ngo bo nyid sku sems can dang sangs rgyas gnyis ka'i gnas skabs su yod mi dgos pa'i tshul de rigs pa yang dag gis shes dgos te/ mgo 'khor bar mi bya'o/ / sangs rgyas ma thag pa'i tshe sems bden stong de gsar du sangs rgyas pa yin pas/ de lta na de yi rtag par 'gyur ram snyam du dogs par mi bya ste/ nam sgrib pa mtha' dag gsar du spangs pa'i tshe de spangs pa'i ldog cha nas ngo bo nyid skur 'jog pa yin gyi/ de'i sngon du ngo bo nyid sku'i tha snyad mi 'thob pa'i phyir ro/ /de mi rtag par mi 'gyur te/ de'i tshe bden stong tsam de gsar du byung ba min par sngar nas kyang yod pa'i phyir ro/ /des na mkhas rmongs la grags pa'i rtag pa 'jog tshul la khyad par yod pas blun po'i 'dod pa ltar rtag pa'i don la 'khrul bar mi bya ste/ 'di dag zhib tu 'chad dgos na'ang mang du dogs so/ /bzhi ba sems can thams cad la sangs rgyas kyi khams yod pa'i sgrub byed bshad pa la gnyis/ sgrub byed spyir bstan pa dang*/ khams dri mas sgrib tshul dpe don sbyar te bshad pa'o/ /dang po la/ rgyud bla rtsa 'grel las rgyu mtshan du ma bshad kyang*/ 'dir go bde ba'i dbang du byas na/ sems can thams cad kyi rgyud la sangs rgyas kyi rigs yod pa yin te/ de thams cad kyi rgyud la sangs rgyas kyi 'phrin las 'jug rung yin zhing sems rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa glo bur gyi dri mas sgrib pa de nyid lam bsgoms pa'i stobs kyis spong nus su 'grub pa'i phyir te/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyis sems can thams cad kyi rgyud la dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed pa'i 'phrin las mdzad pa'i phyir dang*/ gang zag dang chos kyi bdag 'dzin gnyis kyang zhen yul 'khrul ba'i phyir/

dper na thag khra la sbrul 'dzin gyi blo bzhin no/ /de ltar yang*/ 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis/ de ni rang gzhan gnyis ka dang*/ /dus gsum nyid du ma thob phyir/ / ngar 'dzin par ni zad par 'gyur/ /de las las dang skye ba yang*/ /zhes dang*/ rnam 'grel las kyang*/ rgyu yod phyir na rgyu yi ni/ /gnyen pos bsgoms pas zad phyir ro/ /zhes mang du gsungs pa ltar ro/ /gal te sems can gyi sems bden stong rang bzhin du gnas pa'i rigs yin kyang*/ rgyu 'bras kyi bya ba byed mi nus pa'i 'dus ma byas yin pas/ de la brten nas sangs rgyas su 'gyur ba 'bad pas bsgrubs pa des ci bya zhe na/ skyon med de/ de'i dgongs pa ni spyir chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis stong bzhin du bya byed 'thad cing*/ chos can kun rdzob pa'i chos thams cad ni chos nyid stong ba'i 'phrul las 'char ba ltar/ sems dang sems bden pas stong ba'i rnam 'gyur las 'khor 'das kyi chos rnams snang gi /bden par grub na bya byed mi 'thad par 'gyur ba'i phyir/ de skad du'ang*/ rang bzhin gyis ni stong ba la/ bya byed 'thad pa'ang mi 'gal zhing*/ zhes dang*/ chos rnams rang bzhin 'ga' yod na/ mya ngan 'das pa mi rung zhing*/ /spros kun ldog pa med par gsungs/ /zhes 'byung ba ltar ro/ /de lta na'ang sems bden stong des 'khor 'das kyi chos gzhan gyi brten pa'i gzhi byed pa yin gyi/ skyed byed kyi rgyu byed pa min no/ /gzhan yang*/ nam mkha' thogs bcas bkag tsam la 'jog cing*/ de la gnas skabs sprin sogs kyis sgrib pa yod kyang*/ nam mkha'i ngo bo ni chos kun dang phyogs kun khyab pa dang sgrib med kyi rang bzhin can yin pa ltar/ sems can gyi sems rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa'i stong ba nyid de yang dgag bya bden grub bkag tsam la 'jog cing*/ de la gnas skabs sprin lta bu'i dri mas bsgribs pa yod kyang ngo bo ni dri ma'i rang bzhin la ma zhugs shing snga phyi kun du'ang yod pa'i phyir te/

rgyud bla las/ nam mkha' kun du rjes song ltar/ /sems kyi rang bzhin dri med dbyings/ /de bzhin kun du 'gro ba nyid/ /de spyi'i mtshan nyid nyes pa dang*/ /yon tan mthar thug khyab pa ste/ /gzugs kyi rnam pa dman pa dang*/ / bar ma mchog la nam mkha' bzhin/ /nyes pa glo bur ldan pa dang*/ /yon tan rang bzhin ldan pa'i phyir/ /ji ltar sngar bzhin phyis de bzhin/ /'gyur ba med pa'i chos nyid do/ /ji ltar nam mkha' kun song ba/ /phra phyir nyes pas gos pa med/ /de bzhin sems can thams cad la/ /gnas 'di nye bar gos pa med/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /sdud pa las kyang*/ nam mkha'i khams ni shar gyi phyogs dang lho phyogs dang*/ /de bzhin nub kyi phyogs dang byang phyogs pha mtha' yas/ /steng dang 'og dang phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten rnams na'ang yod/ /tha dad gyur ba med cing bye brag gyur ba'ang med/ /'das pa'i de bzhin nyid gang ma byon de bzhin nyid/ /da ltar de bzhin nyid gang dgra bcom de bzhin nyid/ /chos kun de bzhin nyid gang rgyal ba'i de bzhin nyid/ /zhes dang*/ 'jig rten de bzhin nyid dang dgra bcom de bzhin nyid/ /rang rgyal de bzhin nyid dang rgyal sras de bzhin nyid/ /gcig pa nyid de dngos bral gzhan min de bzhin nyid/ /zhes 'khor 'das rang bzhin gyis stong ba'i chos dbyings rnams rigs gcig par bstan to/ /chos rnams kyi de bzhin nyid thams cad rigs gcig yin kyang gcig ma yin pa'i tshul legs par shes na ni/ lta ngan mang bo spong nus so/ /yang*/ nam mkha' la rlung*/ de la chu/ de la sa brten pa yin yang*/ nam mkha' ni de rnams la brten pa min pa ltar/ sems rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa la tshul min yid byed dang*/ de la las nyon dang*/ de la brten nas phung khams sogs 'byung yang*/ sems bden bas stong pa'i rang bzhin de de rnams la rag las pa'i tshul gyis brten pa min te/ de ltar rgyud bla las/

sa ni chu la chu rlung la/ /rlung ni mkha' la rab tu gnas/ /mkha' ni rlung dang chu dag dang*/ /sa yi khams la gnas ma yin/ /de bzhin phung bo khams dbang rnams/ /las dang nyon mongs dag la gnas/ /las dang nyon mongs tshul bzhin min/ /yid la byed la rtag tu gnas/ /tshul bzhin ma yin yid byed ni/ / sems kyi dag pa la rab gnas/ /sems kyi rang bzhin chos rnams ni/ /thams cad la yang gnas pa med/ /ces gsungs so/ /de bzhin du sems kyi dag pa la tshul bzhin yid la byed pa dang*/ de la ye shes dang*/ de la brten nas thar ba dang thams cad mkhyen pa 'grub tshul la'ang sbyor rgyu yin no/ /'di lta bu zhig mdo sdud pa las kyang gsungs te/ de nyid las/ mkha' la rlung rten de la chu yi phung bo brten/ /de la sa chen 'di brten de la 'gro ba brten/ /sems can las la spyod pa'i rgyu ni de 'dra ste/ /nam mkha' gang la gi nas yin don 'di bsam par gyis/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad kyang 'grub tshul de dang 'dra bar bstan te/ gsang 'dus rtsa rgyud las/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi chos/ gang na gnas gang nas byung*/ dpal rdo rje sems dpas bka' stsal ba/ rang gi lus dang ngag dang sems las byung ngo*/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis gsol ba/ sems gang na gnas/ bka' stsal ba/ nam mkha' la gnas so/ /gsol ba/ nam mkha' gang na gnas/ bka' stsal ba/ gang na yang mi gnas so/ /zhes gsungs te/ 'di'i nam mkha' ni sems rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa yin no/ /sngags kyi skabs su 'byung bzhi dang rten brten pa'i dkyil 'khor rnams stong ba'i ngang las bskyed pa yang sngar bshad pa'i gnad de lta bu yod pa la dgongs so/ /mdor na chos thams cad don dam dpyod byed kyi rigs pa yang dag gis dpyad de btags don btsal na mthar rnyed rgyu med pa'i gzhi med rtsa bral stong ba nam mkha' ltar 'gyur ba yin na yang*/

stong ba'i ngang las kun rdzob tu 'khor 'das kyi rnam bzhag thams cad 'thad tshul de lta bu zhig yod pa ni/ sngar bshad pa de dag gi don te shes na ngo mtshar che ba'i gnas kyang yin no/ /'di yang mthar gtugs na dbu ma'i rigs pa rnams legs par shes dgos pa la rag las so/ /sems rang bzhin gyis stong yang sems skye 'jig byed pa'i tshe/ sems rang bzhin gyi stong ba skye 'jig byed mi dgos te/ dper na snod bcud skye 'jig byed pa'i tshe nam mkha' skye 'jig byed mi dgos pa lta bu'o/ /rang bzhin gyi stong ba spyi dang bye brag sems rang bzhin gyis stong ba mi shes pa'i ma rig pa'i dbang gis 'khor bar 'khor ba dang*/ sems rang bzhin gyis stong ba nyid shes pa'i shes rab kyi stobs kyis thar ba dang thams cad mkhyen pa 'grub par 'gyur ba yin te/ sdud pa las/ sems can tha ma 'bring dang mchog gyur ji snyed pa/ /de kun ma rig las byung bde bar gshegs pas gsung*/ /rkyen rnams tshogs nas sdug bsngal 'khrul 'khor rab tu 'byung*/ / zhes dang*/ ye shes tshul sgo thabs dang rtsa ba ji snyed pa/ /de kun shes rab pha rol phyin las byung*/ /rkyen rnams tshogs nas ye shes 'khrul 'khor rab tu 'byung*/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa khams dri mas sgrib tshul dpe don sbyor ba la gnyis/ dpe dgu dang*/ don dgu'o/ /dang po ni/ pad+ma ngan pa'i nang na sangs rgyas kyi sku yod pa sogs sgrib bya sgrib byed kyi dpe dgu yod de/ rgyud bla las/ sangs rgyas pad ngan sbrang rtsi sbrang ma la/ /sbun la snying bo mi gtsang na'ang gser/ /sa la gter dang myug sogs 'bras chung dang*/ /gos hrul nang na rgyal ba'i sku dang ni/ /bud med ngan ma'i lto na mi bdag dang*/ /sa la rin chen gzugs yod ci lta bar/ / glo bur nyon mongs dri mas bsgribs pa yi/ /sems can rnams la de bzhin khams 'di gnas/ /zhes sgrib byed pad+ma ngan pa sogs dgus bsgrib bya sangs rgyas kyi sku brnyan sogs dgu bsgribs pa de bzhin du/

sgrib byed chags sogs nyon mongs pa du mas bsgrib bya sangs rgyas kyi khams bsgribs te rtogs dka' bar bstan te/ de yang sgrib byed pad+ma dang sbrang ma dang spun pa dang mi gtsang ba dang sa dang 'bras chung dang gos hrul dang bud med dang sa'i khong ste dgus/ bsgrib bya sangs rgyas kyi sku dang sbrang rtsi dang snying bo dang gser dang gter dang n+ya gro dha dang rin po che'i sku dang rgyal rigs dang rin po che ste dgu bsgribs pa dang rim par sbyor ro/ /gnyis pa dpe de don dgu dang sbyor tshul so sor rgyas par bshad du yod kyang 'dir bsdu na/ dpe dgus bsgrib byed dgu bsgribs pa de mngon shes dang ldan pa'i gang zag gis/ gzhan dag la gsal bar ston nus pa ltar/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis kyang rigs drug gi 'gro ba mtha' dag la sangs rgyas kyi rigs rang bzhin gnas rigs yod par gzigs nas 'jig rten du byon te chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i sgo nas rigs kyi sgrib byed chags sogs rnams bsal te/ gnas skabs mngon mtho dang tshogs sbyor mthong sgom gyi lam rim gyis bskyed pa'i sgo nas/ mthar thug nges legs la 'god par mdzad pa yin te/ rgyud bla las/ ji ltar mdog can pad+ma'i khong gnas pa/ / mtshan stong gis 'bar de bzhin gshegs pa ni/ /dri med lha yi mig ldan mis mthong nas/ /chu skyes 'dab ma'i sbubs nas 'byin byed pa/ /de bzhin bde gshegs mnar med 'gro la yang*/ /sangs rgyas spyan gyis rang chos nyid gzigs te/ /sgrib med phyi mtha'i mur gnas thugs rje yi/ /bdag can sgrib pa las ni grol bar byed/ /zhes pa nas/ rang bzhin 'od gsal dri ma rnams kyang ni/ /glo bur bar ni rnam par gzigs gyur nas/ /rin chen 'byung gnas lta bu'i 'gro ba rnams/ /sgrib pa dag las sbyong mdzad byang chub mchog /zhes pa'i bar gsungs pa ltar ro/ /lnga ba byang chub bshad pa la gsum/

chos sku/ longs sku/ sprul sku'o/ /'di dag ni sngar sangs rgyas dkon mchog gi skabs su cung zad bshad mod/ 'dir byang chub sgos su 'chad pa'i skabs yin pas/ chos sku la spangs pa mthar thug dang*/ rtogs pa mthar thug gnyis yod pa'i snga ma ni ngo bo nyid sku ste/ sngar bshad pa'i sems can gyi rgyud kyi sems rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa de nyid/ sgrib pa mtha' dag dang bral ba'i sangs rgyas kyi ngo bor gyur pa'i tshe ngo bo nyid sku zhes bya la/ sangs rgyas kyi yon tan gzhan thams cad kyi rten gzhi byed do/ /sngags kyi skabs su chos sku nam mkha' bzhin du dbyer med kyang*/ /zhes dang*/ 'jam dpal rang bzhin chos rnams kun gyi dngos/ /gnas med 'gro 'ong bral ba nam mkha' bzhin/ zhes gsungs pa'ang 'di la dgongs pa'o/ /'dir byang chub zhes pa ni dag pa gnyis ldan gyi sku yin pa la byed cing*/ spyir sangs rgyas thams cad kyang byang chub chen po yin zhing*/ khyad par du spangs rtogs mthar thug la byang chub ces bya'o/ /ngo bo nyid sku de yon tan du ma dang ldan pa yin te/ 'chad par 'gyur ba'i yon tan rnams dang ldan pa'i phyir/ de chos can rang bzhin dag pa'i yon tan dang ldan te/ rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa'i dbyings mthar thug yin pa'i phyir/ glo bur gyi dri ma mtha' dag spangs pa'i yon tan dang ldan te/ chags sogs nyon mongs pa dang shes bya'i sgrib pa bag chags dang bcas pa gtan nas spangs pa'i phyir/ rtag pa yin te/ las nyon gyi skye ba dang bral ba'i 'dus ma byas kyi chos yin pa'i phyir/ brtan pa yin te/ mthar 'chi ba med cing 'gag pa med pa'i chos yin pa'i phyir/ zhi ba yin te/ nyes skyon ma lus pa spangs pa'i spangs pa yin pa'i phyir/ g.yung drung yin te/ rga ba med pa'i chos nyid yin pa'i phyir/ zag med bde ba'i gnas yin te/ sdug bsngal rgyu dang bcas pa spangs pa'i zhi ba yin pa'i phyir/

de skad du yang*/ rgyud bla las/ skye dang bral phyir rtag pa ste/ /'gag med phyir na brtan pa nyid/ /gnyis med phyir de zhi ba ste/ /g.yung drung chos nyid gnas phyir ro/ /rab zhi 'gog pa'i bden pa'i phyir/ /zhes so/ /spyir chos nyid rtogs dka' zhing*/ khyad par du ngo bo nyid sku de mngon sum du rtogs dka' ba'i zab mo yin te/ rgyud bla las/ phra phyir thos pa'i yul min te/ /don dam yin phyir bsam bya min/ /chos nyid zab phyir 'jig rten pa'i/ /bsgom pa la sogs yul ma yin/ /gang phyir gzugs la dmus long bzhin/ /byis pas de sngon mthong ma myong*/ /btsas pa'i khyim na bu chung gis/ /nyi ma'i gzugs bzhin 'phags pas kyang*/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar te/ rkang ba phyi ma gnyis kyis slob pa 'phags pas kyang rtogs dka' ba'i dpe bstan pa yin no/ /mdor na ngo bo nyid sku de mtshan nyid lnga yon tan lnga dang ldan pa yin te/ skye 'jig sogs dang bral ba'i 'dus ma byas dang*/ chos dbyings ngo bo dbyer med pa dang*/ sgro skur gyi mtha' dang bral ba dang*/ /nyon sgrib shes sgrib snyoms 'jug gi sgrib pa gsum las grol ba dang*/ dri ma med cing rnam par rtog pa med pa sogs kyis 'od gsal ba'i mtshan nyid can gyi yon tan lnga dang*/ rgya che ba'i mtha' 'di tsam mo zhes gzhal du med pa dang*/ grangs tshad 'di tsam mo zhes bgrang mi nus pa dang*/ rtog ges mu bzhir bsam du med pa dang*/ gzhan la med pas mi mnyam pa dang*/ /sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa dag pa'i yon tan lnga dang ldan pa'i phyir te/ rgyud bla las/ de la sangs rgyas rnams kyi ni/ /ngo bo nyid sku mtshan nyid lnga/ /mdor na yon tan lnga dang ni/ /ldan pa nyid du shes par bya/ /'dus ma byas shing rnam dbyer med/ /mtha' gnyis dag ni rnam par spangs/ /nyon mongs shes bya snyoms 'jug gi /sgrib gsum las ni nges grol te/ /dri med rnam par rtog med dang*/

/rnal 'byor rnams kyi yul yin phyir/ /chos dbyings ngo bo nyid kyis ni/ /dag pa'i phyir na 'od gsal ba/ /zhes dang*/ gzhal med grangs med bsam med pa/ /mnyam med dag pa'i mthar thug pa'i/ /yon tan rnams dang yang dag par/ /ngo bo nyid kyi sku ldan de/ /rgya che'i phyir dang grangs med phyir/ /rtog ge'i yul ni min phyir dang*/ /'ba' zhig bag chags bcas spangs phyir/ /gzhal med la sogs go rim bzhin/ /zhes so/ /rtogs pa mthar thug ni rnam mkhyen yin pas/ de'i khyad chos mang du bshad kyang 'dir mi 'chad la/ mdor na ji lta ji snyed kyi shes bya'i gnas rnams la chags pa med cing thogs pa med pa ste/ dper na gzugs la nyi ma bzhin no/ /de skad du yang*/ nyon mongs spangs phyir chags pa med/ /shes bya'i sgrib kun dag pa'i phyir/ /thams cad du ni thogs pa med/ /ces so/ /gnyis pa longs sku la/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi thog mar chos sku rnam pa gnyis brnyes pa'i rten ni longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku yin la/ sangs rgyas kyi gzugs sku yon tan gyi rnam pa yongs su rdzogs shing mthar thug pa gzhan dang thun mong ma yin pa'i sku yang de nyid do/ /'di ni ye shes kyi sku can yin gyi/ sha rus med pas/ khog pa dang nang khrol sogs kyang gtan med do/ /longs sku de nges pa lnga dang ldan pa yin te/ sku dang gnas dang 'khor dang chos dang dus nges pa rnams dang ldan pa'i phyir/ khyad par lnga dang ldan pa yin te/ sku mtshan dpe gsal rdzogs kyis spras pa dang*/ gsung chos ston pa rgyun mi chad pa dang*/ mdzad pa 'phrin las rgyun mi chad pa dang*/ 'bad rtsol med pa dang*/ sku'i bkod pa mi 'dra ba sna tshogs ston pa lnga dang ldan pa'i phyir te/ rgyud bla las/ sna tshogs chos la longs spyod rdzogs/ /rang bzhin chos ni snang phyir dang*/ / thugs rje dag pa'i rgyu mthun pa/ /'gro don rgyun mi chad phyir dang*/

/'dod pa ji bzhin bskong ba'i phyir/ /yid bzhin nor bu'i rdzu 'phrul gyis/ /rdzogs par longs spyod rnam par gnas/ /brjod ston mdzad rgyun mi chad dang*/ /mngon par 'du byed med pa dang*/ /de yi ngo bo min ston la/ /'dir ni sna tshogs rnam lngar brjod/ /ces so/ /gsum pa longs sku'i sprul ba mchog gi sprul sku ni mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi tshul ston pa'i bdag cag gi ston pa lta bu ste/ rgyud bla las/ thugs rje chen pos 'jig rten mkhyen/ /zhes sogs dang*/ dga' ldan gnas nas 'pho ba dang*/ /lhums su 'jug dang bltams pa dang*/ /bzo yi gnas la mkhas pa dang btsun mo'i 'khor dgyes rol ba dang*/ /nges 'byung dka' ba spyod pa dang*/ /byang chub snying bor gshegs pa dang*/ /bdud sde 'joms dang rdzogs par ni/ /byang chub chos kyi 'khor lo dang*/ /mya ngan 'das par gshegs mdzad rnams/ / yongs su ma dag zhing rnams su/ /srid pa ji srid gnas par ston/ /zhes pa ste/ de ni sprul sku khyad par can gyi dbang du byas kyi/ sprul sku gzhan yang bsam gyis mi khyab po/ /de dag gi khyad par gzhan nas shes par bya zhing go bar zad do/ /sprul sku ni sbrul ba pos ji ltar sbrul bzhed pa ltar mchog dman du snang bar 'gyur gyi/ sprul sku'i dbang min pas/ ma dag pa'i gdul bya'i ngo bor tha mal pa ltar snang ba'i sprul ba 'ga' zhig la dus der rang nyid sangs rgyas kyi sprul ba yin min mi shes pa ltar 'gyur srid par ni kho bos lung rigs gnyis kyis sgrub nus mod/ gzhan dang thun mong du ma gyur bas re zhig gsang ba'i gnas so/ /de ltar yod kyang de dag spangs rtogs nyams pa ni min te/ nam gdul bya de mdzad pa mchog gi rnam pas 'dul ba'i dus kyi tshe yang de ltar du 'gyur ba'i phyir/ dper na/ nyi zla la che chung dang gsal mi gsal gnyis med kyang*/ mthong tshul la de ltar yod par ma zad/ chu che chung dang rnyogs ma dang bcas ma bcas la 'char tshul gyi rnam pa mi 'dra ba yod pa bzhin no/

/de skad du yang*/ rgyud blar/ chu dang nam mkhar zla ba bzhin/ /de mthong ba ni rnam pa gnyis/ /zhes so/ /des na sprul sku'i rnam pa mtha' dag ci lta bu yin pa'i tshul ni bsam gyis mi khyab ste/ sangs rgyas kho na'i mngon sum gyi spyod yul lo/ / drug pa yon tan la/ sku'i yon tan ni mtshan dpe gsal rdzogs kyis spras shing*/ gsung yan lag drug bcu dang ldan pa ste sla'o/ /thugs kyi yon tan la spangs rtogs gnyis yod pa'i dang po ni/ dag pa gnyis ldan gyi sku sngar bshad pa ltar yin la/ phyi ma ni/ stobs bcu la sogs pa'o/ /skabs 'di'i yon tan la rnam smin dang*/ ye shes gnyis yod pa'i dang po ni mtshan so gnyis dang dpe byad brgyad cu la bshad cing*/ phyi ma la stobs dang*/ mi 'jigs pa dang*/ ma 'dres pa bco brgyad de sde tshan gsum du bshad pa'i dang po ni gnas dang gnas min mkhyen pa sogs bcu'o/ /gnyis pa ni spangs pa phun tshogs dam bcas pa la mi 'jigs pa sogs bzhi'o/ /gsum pa ni/ rtogs pa ma 'dres pa sogs bco brgyad do/ /'di dag gi khyad par ni gzhan du bshad zin pas 'dir rgyas par mi ston la/ de dag gi byed las ni/ rgyud bla las/ stobs ni ma rig sgrib la rdo rje bzhin/ /mi 'jig nyid ni 'khor du seng ge bzhin/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i ma 'dres mkha' bzhin te/ /zhes dang*/ gnas dang gnas min rnam smin khams dang 'gro dang mos pa sna tshogs dang*/ /nyon mongs rnam byang dbang bo'i tshogs dang sngon ma nas rjes su dran pa dang*/ /lha yi mig dang zag pa zad tshul mi shes go cha rtsig brtan dang*/ shing rnams 'big dang 'jig dang gcod phyir stobs gang yin pa rdo rje bzhin/ / zhes dang*/ chos kun mngon par byang chub dang*/ /gegs ni 'gog par byed pa dang*/ /lam ston pa dang 'gog ston la/ /mi 'jig pa ni rnam pa bzhi/ /zhes sogs dang*/ 'khrul dang ca co mi mnga' ste/ /zhes pa nas/ ma 'dres rtsa 'di ni rdul phran tsam yang 'jig rten dag na thun mong min/

/zhes pa'i bar gsungs te mang du dogs nas ma drangs so/ /don bsdu na/ stobs bcu ni shes bya thams cad la 'jug cing mi mthun phyogs 'joms pa la thogs pa med pas na lha'i dbang bos rdo rje rin po che dang chos mtshungs la/ mi 'jigs pa bzhi ni rgyal sras nyan rang rnams dang lha dang mi dang lha ma yin la sogs pa'i 'khor rgya mtsho lta bu'i dbus na chos mthun gyi rgol ba med cing*/ gang la yang mi 'jigs pas na seng ge dang chos mtshungs pa dang*/ ma 'dres pa bco brgyad ni/ so skye nyan rang rgyal sras rnams la de'i rigs mthun tsam yang med pas rtogs rigs ma 'dres shing thun mong ma yin pas na nam mkha' dang chos mtshungs pa'i khyad chos dang ldan no/ /bdun pa 'phrin las la ngo bo/ dbye bas/ 'jug tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ gdul bya mngon mtho dang nges legs ci rigs la bkod pa dang tha na rgyud la dge sems sna gcig skyes pa yang sangs rgyas kyi 'phrin las su bshad pa ltar ro/ /gnyis pa dbye na/ sku gsung thugs kyi 'phrin las gsum mo/ /de re re la'ang byed pa po la yod pa'i 'phrin las dang*/ bya ba yul la yod pa'i 'phrin las gnyis so/ /mngon rtogs rgyan du 'phrin las nyer bdun bshad kyang*/ dbye bsdu'i khyad par ro/ /byed pa po dang bya ba la yod pa'i khyad par yang*/ sangs rgyas kyis sems can gyi don byed pa'i 'phrin las ni byed pa po sangs rgyas nyid la yod cing*/ don byas pa'i 'phrin las ni yul sems can la yod de/ dper na/ shing sta res gcod pa'i byed pa ni gcod byed la yod cing*/ bcad pa'i bya ba ni shing nyid la yod pa bzhin no/ /gsum pa ni rgyud bla'i dpe don rnams rgyas par bshad kyang*/ 'dir bsdu na/ mngon rtogs rgyan las/ de bzhin 'khor ba ji srid 'di'i/ /las ni rgyun mi 'chad par 'dod/ /ces gsungs pa ltar/ sangs rgyas kyi 'phrin las ni gdul bya'i rgyud la rgyun mi chad par 'jug cing*/

de yang dus las mi 'da' ba dang lhun gyis grub pa'i tshul gyis 'jug ste/ mngon rtogs rgyan las/ rgyud ni yongs su smin gyur na/ /gang dang gang la gang dang ni/ /gang tshe bya ba phan gyur ba/ /de dang de la de snang ngo*/ /zhes dang*/ rgyud bla las/ gdul bya'i khams dang gdul ba'i thabs dang ni/ /gdul bya'i khams kyi gdul ba'i bya ba dang*/ /de yi yul dang dus su gshegs pa la/ khyab bdag rtag tu lhun gyis grub par 'jug /ces gsungs pa ltar ro/ /gdul bya rang ngos nas snod du mi rung na ni/ mngon rtogs rgyan las lha yi rgyal bos char phab kyang*/ /sa bon mi rung mi 'khrungs ltar/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni byung gyur kyang*/ /skal ba med pas bzang mi myong*/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar 'gyur ro/ /'phrin las sgrub tshul 'di la dpe dgu dang don dgu yod de/ rgyud bla las/ gang zhig brgya byin rnga dang sprin bzhin dang*/ /tshangs nyi rin chen yid bzhin nor rgyal bzhin/ /sgra brnyan nam mkha' sa bzhin srid pa'i bar/ /'bad med gzhan don byed de rnal 'byor rig /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ brgya byin gyi gzugs brnyan dang lha'i rnga dang sprin dang tshangs pa'i sprul ba dang nyi ma dang yid bzhin gyi nor bu dang*/ sgra brnyan dang nam mkha' dang sa gzhi ste dpe dgus don dgu mtshon par byed do/ /de yang dus 'ga' zhig gi tshe 'dzam gling gi sa steng 'di bai ḍūr+ya'i rang bzhin du gyur ba'i skabs su lha'i dbang bo brgya byin gnas dang bcas pa'i gzugs brnyan sa gzhi der snang ba 'dzam gling gis mi rnams kyis mthong nas/ brgya byin de 'dra bar bdag kyang gyur cig snyam ste smon lam 'debs pa de bzhin du/ las dag pa'i sems can rnams kyi snang ngor sangs rgyas kyi sprul sku yang chos ston pa sogs spyod lam sna tshogs kyis snang ba mthong nas dad smon byed pa sogs kyis don byed pa dang*/ sum cu rtsa gsum na lha'i bsod nams las grub pa'i lha'i rnga bo che zhes bya ba zhig yod pa de las/

dus 'ga' zhig gi tshe brdung ba po med par chos kyi sgra sna tshogs byung ste lha rnams la chos ston pa ltar/ sangs rgyas kyi gsung gis gdul bya la dus su bab pa'i tshe 'bad pa med par chos sna tshogs ston pa dang*/ dbyar dus su sprin las char dus su babs te lo tog sogs bskyed pa ltar/ thugs rje chen po'i sprin las chos kyi char phab ste sems can la mngon mtho nges legs bskyed pa dang*/ tshangs pa chen po ni rang gi gnas su 'dug bzhin du lha'i gnas gzhan rnams su rang gi gzugs kyi snang ba 'bad med du ston pa ltar/ sangs rgyas kyi chos kyi sku las ma g.yos par mdzad pa bcu gnyis sogs 'phrin las sna tshogs mdzad pa dang*/ nyi ma mkha' la shar te pad+mo rnams rgyas shing gling rnams snang ba byed pa ltar/ sangs rgyas kyi 'bad rtsol med par gdul bya smin par byed pa dang smin pa rnams grol bar byed cing phan bde'i lam snang bar mdzad pa dang*/ yid bzhin gyi nor bu la gsol ba btab na rnam rtog med par re ba skong ba ltar/ sangs rgyas kyis 'bad pa med par gzhan don thams cad lhun grub tu mdzad pa dang*/ brag cha las sgra brnyan ni kun slong gi rnam rtog med par 'byung ba ltar/ sangs rgyas kyis 'bad rtsol gyi rnam rtog dang lce rkan sogs la rag las pa med pa'i tshul gyis gdul bya'i bsam ngo dang mthun par chos sna tshogs ston pa dang*/ nam mkha' la don du mtho dman med kyang gzhan gyi snang ngor de yod pa ltar snang ba de bzhin du/ sangs rgyas kyis skye 'chi sogs yod pa ltar snang ba'i sprul ba sna tshogs mdzad pa blo dman gyi ngor snang yang snang ba ltar med bzhin du don sgrub par byed pa dang*/ sa gzhis lo tog sogs kyi rten gzhi byed cing 'di dang 'di rten no bskyed do snyam pa'i rnam par rtog pa med kyang de rnams byed pa ltar/ sangs rgyas kyis ngas sems can 'di dang 'di'i don bya'o snyam pa'i 'bad rtsol gyi rnam par rtog pa med par 'gro ba'i dge legs thams cad bskyed cing gnas pa dang 'phel bar mdzad do/

/de ltar rgyud bla las/ ji ltar bai ḍūr sa gzhi gtsang ma la/ /lha dbang lus kyi gzugs brnyan snang ba ltar/ /de bzhin 'gro sems sa gzhi gtsang ma la/ /thub pa'i dbang bo'i sku'i gzugs brnyan 'char/ /zhes dang*/ lha rnams thams cad yang nas yang*/ /chos kyi rngas ni bskul ba ltar/ /de bzhin khyab bdag 'bad sogs dang*/ /bral yang 'gro ba ma lus pa/ /sangs rgyas gsung gis khyab mdzad de/ /skal ldan rnams la chos ston to/ /zhes dang*/ ji ltar dbyar gyi dus na sprin/ /lo tog phun sum tshogs pa'i rgyu/ /chu yi phung bo 'bad med par/ /sa la rgyun du 'bebs pa ltar/ /de bzhin thugs rje'i sprin las ni/ /rgyal ba'i dam chos chu yi char/ /'gro ba'i dge ba'i lo tog tu/ /rnam par rtog pa med par 'bebs/ /zhes dang*/ ji ltar tshangs pa tshangs pa yi/ /gnas nas 'pho ba med bzhin du/ /lha yi gnas ni thams cad du/ /snang ba 'bad med ston pa ltar/ /de bzhin thub pa chos sku las/ /bskyod pa med par khams kun du/ /skal ldan rnams la 'bad med par/ /sprul ba dag ni ston par mdzad/ /zhes dang*/ ji ltar nyi ma rtog med par/ /rang 'od cig char spros pa yis/ /pad+ma rgyas par byed pa dang*/ /gzhan dag smin par byed pa ltar/ /de bzhin de bzhin gshegs pa yi/ /nyi ma dam chos 'od zer dag /gdul bya'i skye bo'i pad+ma la/ /rnam par rtog pa med par 'jug /zhes dang*/ ji ltar yid bzhin nor bu ni/ /rtog pa med kyang cig car du/ /spyod yul gnas pa rnams kyi ni/ /bsam kun yongs su rdzogs pa ltar/ /de bzhin sangs rgyas yid bzhin la/ /brten nas bsam pa tha dad rnams/ /sna tshogs chos ni thos gyur kyang*/ /de ni de la rnam mi rtog /zhes dang*/ ji ltar sgra brnyan gyi ni sgra/ /gzhan gyi rnam rig las byung ba/ /rnam rtog med cing bzo med la/ /phyi dang nang na mi gnas ltar/ /de bzhin de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsung*/ /gzhan gyi rnam rig las byung ba/

/rnam par rtog pa bzo med cing*/ /phyi dang nang na gnas ma yin/ /zhes dang*/ ji ltar mkha' las mtho dang dma'/ /mthong yang de ni de lta min/ /de bzhin thams cad sangs rgyas la/ /mthong yang de ni de la min/ /zhes dang*/ ji ltar sa la brten nas ni/ / 'phel zhing brtan dang yangs 'gyur ltar/ /de bzhin rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sa/ /rnam rtog med la brten nas ni/ /'gro ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba ni/ /ma lus pa ni 'phel bar 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /bsdu na sangs rgyas kyi sku'i 'phrin las ni/ 'jug pa las/ ba spu'i khur bur byang chub sems rnams dang*/ /lhan cig rdzogs sangs rgyas sku grangs 'das dang*/ /de bzhin lha dang lha min mi dag kyang*/ /skad cig re re la yang ston par nus/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ sangs rgyas kyis 'bad rtsol med par sku'i ba spu'i khung bu re re nas kyang rang gi dus gsum gyi mdzad pa kun dang*/ sprul pa grangs med cig car ston nus shing*/ rdul phra rab gcig nyid kyi go sar yang mtha' yas pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams shong nus par mdzad pa sogs dang*/ gsung dbyangs gcig nyid kyang gdul bya rang rang gi skad du go zhing the tshom ma lus pa gcod nus pa dang*/ thugs mkhyen pa gcig gis kyang ji ltar ji snyed kyi chos thams cad mngon sum du gzigs pa'i ye shes dang ldan te/ gsang ba chen po gsum dang ldan pa'o/ /de lta bu'i gsang ba gsum po thams cad byang sems man chad kyis mngon sum gyi yul min te/ ji skad du/ khyod kyi sku gsung thugs kyi gsang ba yi/ /tshul 'di rgyal sras rang rgyal nyan thos kyis/ /ci tsam brtags kyang blo yi yul min na/ /tshangs dang dbang bo sogs kyis smos ci 'tshal/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa ltar/ dbu ma 'jug par yang gsungs so/ /de lta bu'i gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i tshul la dge ba'i rtsa ba ma bskyed pa'i blo dman yid mi ches shing*/ mos dka' ba la dgongs nas/

dpal ldan zla bas dbu ma 'jug pa las/ 'on kyang khyod kyi gsang ba 'di ni bsnyad bgyid ma lags so/ /zhes gsungs so/ /gnyis pa phan yon la/ gong du brjod pa ltar don bdun po de la mos shing thos bsam gyis 'dug pa la phan yon ji lta bu yod ce na/ de yang rje btsun byams mgon nyid kyis rgyud bla ma las/ gang zhig byang chub don du gnyer bas gser zhing nor bus spras pa ni/ /sangs rgyas zhing rdul mnyam pa nyin re chos rgyal rnams la rtag phul bas/ /gzhan gang 'di las tshig tsam thos shing thos nas kyang ni mos na 'di/ /sbyin pa las byung dge ba de las bsod nams ches mang 'thob par 'gyur/ /blo ldan gang zhig bla med byang chub 'dod pas bskal ba du mar yang*/ /lus ngag yid kyis 'bad pa med par tshul khrims dri med srung byed pa/ /gzhan gang 'di las tshig tsam thos shing thos nas kyang ni mos na 'di/ /tshul khrims las byung dge ba de las bsod nams ches mang 'thob par 'gyur/ /gang zhig 'di na srid pa gsum gyi nyon mongs me 'jil bsam gtan ni/ /lha dang tshangs gnas mthar son rdzogs pa'i byang chub 'pho med thabs bsgom la/ /gzhan gang 'di las tshig tsam thos shing thos nas kyang ni mos na 'di/ /bsam gtan las byung dge ba las bsod nams ches mang 'thob par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar yod cing*/ de yang 'di thos nas mos pa'i dge bas 'di lta bu sngar ma thos pa'i so skye rnams kyi dge ba de gsum zil gyis gnon pa'i don yin gyi/ 'di lta bu sngar shes zin mos pa'i dge ba de lta bu zil gyis gnon pa'i don min zhing*/ 'phags pa'i bsgoms byung gis thob pa'i bsod nams khyad par can yang min no/ /de ltar gsungs pa de ni sgra ji bzhin pa nyid yin gyi/ drang don dgongs pa can ni gtan min par 'di'i rgya bod kyi 'grel par shes so/ kho bos kyang phan yon de don du gnyer ba'i bsam pas/ mdo nas 'byung ba'i dgongs pa mthar thug 'phags pa mi pham mgon gyis legs par bkral ba'i bstan bcos 'di'i don gyi snying bo bsdus te rje yab sras kyi bzhed pa bzhin du bshad pa yin la/

dad dang rnam dpyod ldan pa dag gis ni tshul 'di la 'bad pas 'jug rigs so/ /smras pa/ ston pas gsungs pa'i chos kyi phung bo ni/ /brgyad khri bzhi stong drang dang nges pa'i don/ /rnam pa mang yang nges don mthar thug pa'i/ /mdo sde'i dgongs 'grel bstan bcos 'di las gang*/ /dpe tshogs ngag 'don tsam zhig mkhas pa dang*/ /tha snyad yig rigs sdeb sbyor tsam shes dang*/ /don la mi reg rigs pa ltar snang yang*/ /chos tshul 'di 'dra'i drung na chu shing bzhin/ /kwa ye grogs dag yid bzhin nor 'dra ba'i/ /zab don rin chen snying bo len pa'i ched/ /'bad par rigs kyi phyi shun lta bu'i gnas/ /snying bo chung la gtso bor 'bad pas ci/ /thog ma med pa'i 'khor bar 'khor 'khor nas/ /srid pa'i phun tshogs gang zhig ma thob dang*/ /bde sdug ma myong bya ba cang med kyang*/ / don bzang 'di 'dra rnyed pa da res tsam/ /'on kyang rgyal tshab dam pa'i dgongs pa kun/ /zab cing rtogs dka' bdag lta'i yul min pas/ /ma gsal log par bshad pa'i nyes pa gang*/ /snying nas 'chags so brtse ba'i thugs rjes dgongs/ /gzhan min dad pas yid dbang 'phrog gyur te/ /tshul 'dir 'bad las byung ba'i dge des bdag /mi pham mgon gyis dgyes bzhin rjes bzung nas/ /rtag tu rgyal ba'i dam chos 'dzin gyur cig /ces pa 'di'ang co ne'i mtshan nyid dang rgyud kyi gdan sa phan tshun zung 'brel gyis skyong ba shākya'i dge slong rigs pa smra ba grags pa bshad sgrub kyis/ rje btsun byams mgon mnyes pa'i mchod par bsams te gus pas sbyar ba'o// //
mes po'i shul bzhag las/ co ne grags pa bshad sgrub kyi gsung 'bum/ theg pa chen po rgyud bla ma'i don gyi snying pogasal byed kyi snang ba chen po bzhugs/ - PAGE 30-- PAGE 31-- PAGE 1-
